insights.title: Insights
insights.empty: Insights appear once there is traffic in {{period}}.
insights.busiestHour: The busiest hour was {{when}} with {{tokens}} tokens, {{share}} of {{period}}.
insights.busiestDay: The busiest day was {{when}} with {{tokens}} tokens, {{share}} of {{period}}.
insights.noneMeasured: None of the {{prompt}} prompt tokens was measured: they were read before the engine reported its prefix cache.
insights.noCounter: This engine does not publish a prefix-cache counter, so the cache hit rate cannot be measured — only the per-response split knows it.
insights.partlyMeasured: The prefix cache served {{rate}} of the {{measured}} prompt tokens it was measured on ({{unreported}} more were not reported).
insights.cacheServed: The prefix cache served {{rate}} of prompt tokens, so about {{cached}} prefill tokens did not have to be recomputed.
insights.noCacheHits: No prompt tokens were served from the prefix cache: either prefix caching is off or no prompt reused an earlier one.

insights.ratio: For every generated token, {{ratio}} prompt tokens were read: {{shape}}.

about.title: About this data
about.bucketsAfter: ; hourly buckets are UTC hours shown in the time zone from Settings (browser default).
about.restarts: Counters that go backwards (an engine restart) are re-seeded from the new value, so a restart never inflates totals. Tokens served right before a restart can be missed.
about.retention: Hourly history is kept for {{hours}} hours and daily history for {{days}} days. The hourly view only has data from when it was first recorded.
about.allTimeBody: is the lifetime total since tracking began; its chart shows the retained daily buckets.
about.allTimeBodyFallback: is the lifetime total since tracking began (unavailable right now, so the retained days are summed instead); its chart shows the retained daily buckets.
about.definitions: Generated = tokens the model wrote. Prompt = tokens it read. Cached prefill is the part of the prompt served from the prefix cache; computed prefill is the rest. Prompt read while the engine published no prefix-cache counter is shown as not reported: it is neither cached nor computed, and the hit rate covers only the prompt whose split was measured.
about.noPrevious: No change-vs-previous figures are shown because the previous {{span}} were not fully tracked.
